name: Drifter's Longsword
description: A plain blade with more nicks along the edge than marks of the whetstone.

name: Drifter's Mace
description: An iron head bolted to a cart axle; it dents what it cannot cut.

name: Drifter's Scimitar
description: A curved blade won at dice from a caravan guard who never asked for it back.

name: Drifter's Greatsword
description: An old two-handed blade, reground so often it is shorter than it should be.

name: Drifter's Shortsword
description: A short blade wrapped in rag at the grip, quick to hand and easy to hide.

name: Drifter's Dagger
description: A thin knife for bread, rope, and the occasional unwary throat.

name: Recruit's Longsword
description: Issued from the barracks rack; the last owner's name is still scratched on the hilt.

name: Recruit's Mace
description: A heavy drill mace, balanced for parade more than for battle.

name: Recruit's Saber
description: A cavalry saber handed to foot soldiers after the horses were sold.

name: Recruit's Greatsword
description: A wall-guard's blade, long enough to keep a nervous recruit at a safe distance.

name: Recruit's Shortsword
description: A standard sidearm, dull from use on crates and kitchen rations.

name: Recruit's Dagger
description: A plain issue dagger, more often used to open letters from home than to fight.
